summary: Release 3 retains the healthy release 2 runtime closure and restores the material persisted-cache and overlap stack that produced approximately 15-second page-cold API readiness in the source experiments.

supersedes.immutability_guard: Release 2, its manifest, and its derived image remain unchanged. Build and select a new release 3 image; never retag or mutate release 2 in place.

delivery.application_guard: Export the complete vllm Python package from source.code_commit. Do not copy only the release 3 changed files onto either release 2 or the v0.27.1 Python package.
delivery.configuration_guard: A profile/configuration run may select an existing image for this patch set, but must not build or modify it.
delivery.release_guard: The fleet must assign release 3 a new immutable image tag and digest. Release 2 remains the rollback target until every release 3 promotion gate passes.

components.reason: Move processor warmup off the serial engine-start critical path while retaining warmup behavior.
components.removal_condition: Remove after an equivalent upstream implementation is present in the pinned base.

components.reason: Expose queue depth, reader count, bounce-buffer size, copy-block size, and direct-I/O selection through model_loader_extra_config.
components.removal_condition: Remove after the installed vLLM and FastSafetensors releases expose equivalent validated controls.

components.reason: Avoid materializing non-local Qwen byte ranges and avoid duplicate MTP embedding and lm_head loads.
components.removal_condition: Remove after the Qwen implementations upstream provide equivalent filtering and weight sharing.

components.reason: Use aligned O_DIRECT reads for cold selected ranges and buffered reads for resident checkpoints.
components.removal_condition: Remove after the behavior is available in compatible released vLLM and FastSafetensors versions.

components.reason: Persist and reuse an exact KV allocation so redundant multimodal memory profiling can be skipped without disabling compilation, warmup, sampling, or CUDA graphs.
components.removal_condition: Remove after the pinned vLLM release persists the exact allocation with equivalent fingerprinting and invalidation.

components.reason: Persist the fingerprinted per-modality maximum-token result that otherwise costs about five seconds independently in the API and EngineCore processes.
components.removal_condition: Remove after equivalent fingerprinted, fail-open multimodal budget persistence is upstream.

components.reason: Construct the renderer and input/output processors concurrently with EngineCore process launch and model initialization.
components.removal_condition: Remove after equivalent frontend construction overlap is upstream.

components.reason: Start an AsyncLLM-preloaded forkserver before importing the large API-server parent graph and make the normal forkserver setup idempotent.
components.removal_condition: Remove after the standard launcher starts the preloaded forkserver before its heavy import graph.

components.reason: On an exact startup-plan hit, profile the language model with the required request/CUDA-graph size rather than max_num_batched_tokens while retaining compilation, sampling, and CUDA graphs.
components.removal_condition: Remove after upstream startup-plan reuse selects a bounded but correctness-complete profiling shape.

components.reason: Persist a fingerprinted alias to the validated AOT artifact, deserialize it in a background thread during weight reads, and accept it only when its resolved path matches the current full AOT hash.
components.removal_condition: Remove after upstream overlaps safe AOT artifact deserialization with model loading.

dependencies.name: fastsafetensors
dependencies.reason: Provides bounded parallel no-GDS reads and adaptive aligned O_DIRECT support required by this patch set.

tested_runtime.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition

compatibility.source_rule: The Python source is pinned to source.code_commit, which is based on source.base_commit from upstream/main and is not the v0.27.1 release source tree.
compatibility.porting_rule: For a different vLLM source release, port every component, update this manifest, and repeat unit, startup, correctness, memory, and serving-performance gates before deployment.

launch.argument_contract: Pass the same serve arguments currently used by the release 2 profile after the module name. Do not invoke the standard vllm CLI for this patch set because it starts the preload forkserver after the large parent import graph.

activation.artifact_precondition: Before enabling offline mode, synchronize the complete pinned model snapshot, tokenizer, processor, configuration, and any remote code required by the profile. A missing local artifact is a failed deployment, not permission to silently remove the offline flags.

mounts.reason: FlashInfer XQA requires either compatible precompiled cubins or a CUDA compiler. This release uses the production host toolkit for JIT compilation.
Persist vLLM startup plans, multimodal budgets, Torch/AOT artifacts and aliases, and FlashInfer JIT artifacts across container removal and model switches.

runtime_requirements.runtime_guard: Apply the activation environment before importing vLLM, FlashInfer, Transformers, or Hugging Face Hub. Run preflights inside the candidate image with the production mounts, not against the unmounted image filesystem.

preflight.execution_context: Inside the candidate container with the production mounts and activation environment applied
argv: import shutil; from vllm.utils.flashinfer import has_flashinfer; assert shutil.which('nvcc') == '/usr/local/cuda/bin/nvcc'; assert has_flashinfer()
preflight.reason: An import-only FlashInfer check does not prove that the selected XQA backend can execute.

additional_preflights.execution_context: Inside the candidate container with the activation environment applied, without starting the service
argv: import vllm; from vllm.compilation.decorators import preload_aot_compiled_fn; from vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server_bootstrap import main; from vllm.multimodal.encoder_budget import _load_mm_max_tokens_cache; assert callable(preload_aot_compiled_fn) and callable(main) and callable(_load_mm_max_tokens_cache)
additional_preflights.reason: Fail closed if the image contains the release 2 package or a partial file overlay instead of the complete pinned release 3 package tree.

release_2_fleet.interpretation: Release 2 validates the loader, XQA runtime closure, and exact startup-plan path but does not contain the later combined approximately 15-second startup stack.

release_3_source_experiments.measurement: Fresh service process and API container, Qwen checkpoint pages explicitly evicted, persistent compile/startup caches retained, /health polled until success.
release_3_source_experiments.qualification: These measurements came from the source experiment environment, not the final release 3 immutable Docker image. Fleet promotion therefore uses a 20-second ceiling rather than treating 14.914 seconds as an attested image result.

source_validation: Repository pre-commit hooks passed for all release 3 source and test files, including Ruff, mypy, SPDX, import, environment-schema, and forbidden-API checks.
Four targeted unit tests passed in a disposable container based on the exact live release 2 image.
The AOT alias test rejected a stale resolved artifact path and consumed the matching artifact deserialized during weight loading.
An executable disposable-container gate started the forkserver before importing the API launcher and then repeated the normal launcher setup idempotently.

requirements: Start release 3 once with the persistent cache mount and complete one representative MTP request; this population boot may exceed 20 seconds.
Verify non-empty startup-plan, multimodal max-token, Torch AOT/Inductor, AOT preload-alias, and FlashInfer XQA cache artifacts under the declared persistent paths.
Stop and remove the container without deleting the cache mount.
Evict only the pinned Qwen checkpoint file pages while retaining the declared persistent startup and compilation caches.
Create a new container from the same immutable release 3 image and profile.
Measure from container process start until the configured API readiness endpoint first succeeds.
Run three independent page-cold repetitions; every repetition must be at most 20.0 seconds and the container restart counter must remain zero.
The logs must show an exact persisted startup-plan hit, an applied multimodal max-token cache, cache-sized language-model profiling, and use of an AOT artifact deserialized during weight loading.
On the page-cold repetition, capture evidence that FastSafetensors selected its cold aligned O_DIRECT path and keep total model loading at or below 5.0 seconds.
On an immediate repetition without checkpoint-page eviction, capture evidence that FastSafetensors selected its resident buffered path and keep total model loading at or below 5.0 seconds.
Both paths must load the target and MTP weights successfully with the configured bounded loader geometry.
The service log selects decode_backend=xqa.
The engine completes profile_cudagraph_memory and CUDA-graph setup without a FlashInfer backend error.
The configured API readiness endpoint succeeds.
The service and container restart counters remain zero from launch through readiness and the representative serving check.
Record the non-empty FlashInfer cache artifact paths after the population run.
After container removal and recreation with the same cache mount, readiness succeeds with XQA and zero restarts without rebuilding the recorded artifacts.
The recorded artifacts remain present and are reused from the persistent mount.
Run the fixed correctness request and representative MTP depth-5 generation used for release 2.
Compare output correctness, TTFT, ITL, throughput, and peak host RAM/VRAM with release 2 and reject material regressions.
Prove direct rollback to the immutable release 2 image/profile.

excluded_experiments.reason: The later extension is below the materiality threshold. Release 3 includes only the earlier max-token result cache that removed about ten seconds across the API and EngineCore processes.
Constructor-only gain with no stable end-to-end win.
Below the agreed materiality threshold and model-specific maintenance cost.
Excluded to keep release 3 generic and maintainable; the material release target is expected to pass without these model/frontend-specific caches.

external_fleet_requirements: Keep the shared-role FlashInfer 0.6.16 Python 3.11 shim that inserts 'from __future__ import annotations' in fd_exchange.py.
Keep the shared-role dependency pins fastapi==0.136.3, starlette==0.52.1, and prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator==7.1.0.
Inject Hugging Face credentials through the fleet secret mechanism for artifact synchronization only; do not place tokens in the image, manifest, profile, service unit, or offline runtime.

rollback.method: Select the immutable release 2 image and profile. Do not mutate release 2 or remove its working runtime mounts while release 3 is being evaluated.
rollback.data: Release 3 startup, Torch, and FlashInfer directories are regenerable cache data and may remain on disk; release-specific fingerprints and full artifact paths prevent them from being accepted as another release's identity.
